svg.title: Lab 05 — DNS before HTTP
svg.desc: Humans type names; the client resolves the name to an IP first, then opens the TCP connection to that address
svg.text: Humans type names; the client resolves the name to an IP first, then opens the TCP connection to that address
UDP 53 — the name has no address yet
answer travels back to the client
only now does the web server see traffic
Ping by IP works but ping by name fails? The problem is DNS (or the DNS server address from DHCP), not routing.
Every name lookup is a separate UDP 53 conversation that happens before the HTTP session.
